clips.title: The story
paras: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Alamar Grimm trains young gnome warlocks. The fall of Gnomeregan has left him bitter, wary of outsiders, and intent on teaching them to wield fel magic and summon an imp.

At Anvilmar, Alamar Grimm carries a deep resentment over Gnomeregan's fall. While other gnomes in Coldridge Valley focus on recovery and tinkering, he distrusts ordinary adventurers and even the Ironforge dwarves who shelter his people. He grumbles that their allies care more about diplomacy with humans than reclaiming the fallen city. Alamar seeks others who share his belief that his people may need ruthless power.

Alamar Grimm guides young gnomes who take up fel magic. A tainted memorandum earns a rare warm welcome, and he begins teaching them basic spells. Before he shares the dangerous knowledge needed to bind a demonic imp, he demands proof of their magical and physical endurance. He sends each novice to retrieve strange feather charms carried by local Frostmane troll novices.
